note: Candidates reviewed for this update but not admitted, with the reason and the evidence that would reopen each.

entries.candidate: VIRTUS Wustermark campus: newer construction observation for the existing imported record (27 October re-check of the fifty-fourth hold)
entries.reason: Re-checked on 27 October 2026: the Gemeinde Wustermark sitemap (local wustermark-sitemap.xml) lists no news item about the 17 October 2026 'Baustellenfest Rechenzentrum' after the event (newest news items: glass containers at Priort, 24 October; events listings to 26 October); the official-notices page (dated items 22 February and 28 September 2026) and the public-display page (landscape plan, 13 October 2026) contain no data-centre item; the B-Plan W 49 'Rechenzentrum 1 Wustermark Nordwest' page (sitemap lastmod 21 May 2026) holds only the plan documents. The existing 1 June 2026 observation stands.
entries.reopen_condition: A dated municipal or VIRTUS report of the 17 October site visit or of construction progress at Wustermark, strictly newer than 1 June 2026 and naming the campus.

entries.candidate: maincubes FRA04 hyperscale data centre (Frankfurt area, 40 MW IT, 'in Planung', ready for service Q3 2029) and FRA05 pipeline (75 MW)
entries.reason: The maincubes FRA04 page (local maincubes-fra04-de.html; datePublished 2025-01-07, dateModified 2026-09-22) describes FRA04 as in planning near Frankfurt with 40 MW IT, 10,000 m2 IT area, a concluded grid-connection contract and expected readiness in Q3 2029, and lists FRA05 (75 MW) as pipeline; it gives no address, municipality, plot or permit, and the modification date is not bounded by an archived copy or a second dated source. The maincubes press sitemap has no item after 1 May 2026. FRA03 (held since the thirty-fourth update) still has no dated maincubes statement.
entries.reopen_condition: A dated maincubes, municipal or authority record naming the FRA04 site (address, B-Plan or parcels) and its stage within 90 days of an update.

entries.candidate: Schwarz Digits / Schwarz Gruppe data centre, Dummerstorf (thirty-fourth hold): attribution of the admitted B-Plan 25b data-centre record
entries.reason: This pass admits the planned large data centre (Giga-Factory) of the 1st amendment of Dummerstorf B-Plan Nr. 25b as announced (Gemeinde notice of 14 October 2026) with a georeferenced plan-area locator, which removes the thirty-fourth hold's locator blocker. The Gemeinde notice names no developer; the Schwarz Gruppe release of 27 August 2026 names only 'the Gewerbegebiet of the Gemeinde Dummerstorf'. The record therefore carries no Schwarz owner/operator role. It is very probably the same project, so the Schwarz hold must not be admitted as a separate site.
entries.reopen_condition: The B-Plan 25b Vorentwurf and Begründung (public from 29 October 2026 on dummerstorf.de and bauportal-mv.de) or a later Schwarz Gruppe/Schwarz Digits or Gemeinde record naming the developer of the B-Plan 25b data centre; then a role can be added with a builder that supports role updates, or a status refresh can cite the naming record.

entries.candidate: Google Kronstorf data centre (Upper Austria; Volo zwei GmbH), first construction stage on KG Stallbach Gst 1454/1, 1454/5, 1455, 1456, 1457, 1458/1, 1458/2, 1459, 1460/2, 1461/1, 1462/1 and 1463/1 (plus KG Kronstorf Gst 1243/2, 1277/1 and 1278)
entries.reason: The status blocker of the thirty-first, thirty-fourth and seventy-second holds is now resolved: the Internet Archive's raw copy of googlekronstorf.at captured 2026-10-07T00:43:03Z (local ia-googlekronstorf-home-20261007.html; CDX listing wayback-cdx-googlekronstorf-domain.json) says 'Google errichtet derzeit ein hochmodernes Rechenzentrum in Kronstorf' (commissioning planned for 2027, initial 150 MW, up to 500 MW) and that 'Im Rahmen des Baus des Rechenzentrums beschäftigt Google derzeit über 200 österreichische Unternehmen'; the site's imprint (archived the same day) names Volo zwei GmbH, Vienna, with a google.com contact, i.e. the project company. The Land Oberösterreich FAQ page 'Google-Datencenter Kronstorf' (live capture and Internet Archive copy of 2026-10-25) says 'Google errichtet in Kronstorf seinen ersten Standort in Österreich' and that the trade-law and building permits for the first stage are issued. The Bezirkshauptmannschaft Linz-Land trade-law permit for the 'Errichtung und Betrieb eines Rechenzentrums' (GZ BHLLBA-2024-339867/162-PM, Linz, 16 December 2025, published by the Land; local landooe-kronstorf-gewerberechtliche-genehmigung-20251216.pdf) names the site parcels listed here and places the Areal east of the B309 Steyrer Straße and north-east of the L571 Kronstorfer Straße, about 2 km south-west of Kronstorf, with the buildings (a 289 x 101 m data hall) in its south-eastern part. The locator blocker remains: no official parcel geometry could be read. BEV's data portal disallows /download in robots.txt and its GeoServer WFS endpoints report 'WFS is disabled'; the BEV WMS lists no cadastral layer; e-gov.ooe.gv.at (DORIS) answers robots.txt with HTTP 403 and kataster.bev.gv.at did not respond; the Land's published zoning plans are 2008-era scans whose parcel layout predates the L571. A Betriebsbaugebiet or road-junction centroid would not meet the locator rule. The permit and the Land FAQ name private neighbours and landowners; none is copied. Not in the Atlas.
entries.reopen_condition: An official parcel geometry for the KG Stallbach parcels named in the permit (BEV/DKM or DORIS from an allowed host, or a georeferenceable current cadastral plan with coordinates), or an operator- or authority-published coordinate or map feature for the data-centre property; then admit as under_construction as of 2026-10-07 (Internet Archive copy of googlekronstorf.at) while within 85 days (until 31 December 2026), or from a newer dated Google, Land OÖ or Kronstorf record.

entries.candidate: Colt Frankfurt 3 (Sossenheim): status refresh from the Internet Archive copy of 11 October 2026
entries.reason: Colt's Frankfurt Three page, in Internet Archive copies of 7 August and 11 October 2026 (local ia-colt-frankfurt-three-20261011.html), still says Colt is 'currently in the process of building the first phase' at Sossenheim, but its structured data give dateModified 2026-05-18, so the statement has not been revised since May; an unchanged older statement re-captured later is not a newer observation, and the existing 19 July 2026 observation already rests on the same wording.
entries.reopen_condition: A dated Colt DCS release or revised page (bounded by an archived copy) reporting Frankfurt 3 progress after 19 July 2026.

entries.candidate: Vantage Zurich I (ZRH1) campus, Winterthur: ZRH11 existing operations and a ZRH12 refresh
entries.reason: The Internet Archive copy of the Vantage Zurich I campus page of 11 October 2026 (local ia-vantage-zurich-i-20261011.html) describes the planned three-building, 40 MW campus but gives no per-building status, so it neither refreshes ZRH12 (under construction as of 30 July 2026) nor dates ZRH11 operations. In addition, the existing site's geometry provenance lists seven geometry evidence IDs while its only project (ZRH12) has one, so a new ZRH11 project could not inherit the campus locator (the same builder limitation as Digital Realty FRA20).
entries.reopen_condition: A dated Vantage or contractor statement naming ZRH11 operations or ZRH12 progress after 30 July 2026, and (for ZRH11) builder support for multi-evidence campus locators.
